The actual API returned DEGRADED alongside completed_with_qc_warnings. The run therefore stopped before t10; this does not establish a production isolation failure.
failure.correction: When a caller explicitly opts to exercise review-required/degraded output, require the wrapper state to be DEGRADED after the fail-closed truth/publish/download assertions. All non-degraded completion paths must still be COMPLETED.
